$comment: Design 7.3 (write matrix) and the 'Who invokes it' column of 6.1. Paths are relative to the e2e root; '**' crosses directories, '*' does not. Roles are agent_type values; 'main' is the main thread (no agent_type) and any agent that is not one of this plugin's.

deny.reason: support/core is the plugin's library and nobody edits it (R4); restore it with /qa:setup if it changed.
support/harness is the plugin's harness and nobody edits it (R4); restore it with /qa:setup if it changed.
the intent review is written only by the test-verifier agent; delegate step 3a to it.
reports are written only by qa-harness (runs, report --promote) and review.md only by test-verifier; use those.

qa:app-mapper.reason: app-mapper writes only app/<app>.driver.ts and app/<app>.map.md (R1); report anything else as an uncertainty.

qa:defect-designer.reason: defect-designer writes only specs/<slug>.defects.json (R1); describe anything else in your answer.

qa:test-verifier.reason: test-verifier writes only specs/<slug>.intent.md and review.md in a run directory (R1); it fixes nothing, so put the finding into your review and verdict.
